articles.title: Tesla to invest 3 bn euros to expand German factory
articles.summary: US electric carmaker Tesla said Monday it will invest three billion euros ($3.4 billion) to expand its German factory, which will in future have capacity to produce one million driverless Cybercabs annually.The new investment would see the construction of an additional production building, which would eventually be able to produce up to one million Cybercabs a year, Tesla said.
